title: hybrid-pillager-drops
description:
A combination of the old pillager drops and new ones. Keeps:
 - ominous potions
 - captain banners
Adds:
 - 40% chance of 1-5 emeralds
 - 5% chance of random lvl. 30 book
body:
# Pillager Drops Datapack

This datapack brings back some classic loot drops to Pillagers, making raids and outposts more rewarding! Now, when you defeat a Pillager, there's a 40% chance they'll drop 1-5 emeralds, just like in the old days. Additionally, there's a 5% chance they'll drop a random enchanted book, giving you a rare but exciting bonus for taking them down.

Perfect for players who want to add a nostalgic touch to their world while keeping the vanilla balance intact. Just install the datapack, and enjoy the enhanced loot!
